# XeraFun Poker (单机德州扑克)

> XeraFun Poker (https://poker.xerafun.com) is a free, mobile-first, single-player Texas Hold'em web game powered by advanced AI and Monte Carlo probability engines. It is an official sub-product of the XeraFun platform (https://xerafun.com).

---

## 1. English Specification

### Overview
- **Product Name**: XeraFun Poker (X-Texas-Holdem)
- **Primary Domain**: https://poker.xerafun.com
- **Parent Platform**: XeraFun (https://xerafun.com)
- **Platform Type**: Single-player Web Application / Mobile-First PWA
- **Access Model**: 100% Free, No download required, No registration, Zero installation, Privacy-friendly (runs entirely in client browser).

### Key Features
- **High-IQ Poker AI**:
  - **Normal Mode**: Strategic position-based play, pot odds assessment, and dynamic bluffing.
  - **Super Mode (Hardcore)**: Real-time Monte Carlo hand equity simulation (thousands of simulations per decision), GTO-inspired hand range modeling, and opponent behavioral profiling (tracking VPIP, PFR, Aggression Factor).
- **Comprehensive Probability Engine**:
  - Hand strength evaluation for 7-card combinations (from High Card to Royal Flush).
  - Main pot and multi-level side pot calculation with fractional chop handling.
  - Board texture analysis (wet vs. dry boards, flush/straight draw detection).
- **Responsive & Immersive UX**:
  - Mobile-first vertical table layout optimized for one-handed touch operation.
  - Dark mode and light mode themes.
  - Full bilingual support (English and Simplified Chinese).
  - Auto-play simulation mode for learning and watching AI vs AI dynamics.

---

## 2. 中文说明 (Chinese Specification)

### 概览
- **产品名称**：XeraFun 德州扑克 (XeraFun Poker)
- **主要访问网址**：https://poker.xerafun.com
- **主平台 / 所属品牌**：XeraFun (https://xerafun.com)
- **产品类型**：纯前端单机 Web 应用 / 移动优先 PWA
- **模式与资费**：100% 免费、无需下载、无需注册、即点即玩、保护隐私（纯本地端运行）。

### 核心特性
- **高智商扑克 AI**：
  - **普通电脑**：基于底池赔率、起手牌范围与位置优势进行理性决策。
  - **超级电脑（硬核模式）**：结合毫秒级蒙特卡洛千次对局胜率模拟（Monte Carlo Equity）、GTO 启发式起手范围、以及玩家打法画像系统（动态追踪 VPIP 入池率、PFR 翻前加注率、激进系数等）。
- **专业扑克计算引擎**：
  - 完整 7 选 5 最佳牌型评估器（从高牌到皇家同花顺）。
  - 主池与多级边池（Side Pots）平分与结算算法。
  - 牌面湿润度与顺子/同花听牌动态分析。
- **极致轻量体验**：
  - 专为手机竖屏触控优化的移动优先界面。
  - 支持中英双语无缝切换与亮色/暗色主题。
  - 内置自动对战托管与复盘排名统计。
